name: Harbourline Ventures Fund II

terms.carry: 20% over an 8% preferred, with a full catch-up
terms.holdNote: A nine-year fund life with two one-year extensions available.

liquidity.source: Expected sell-down; the fund winds up at the end of its life

structure: Twenty-four early-stage companies in one fund. A fund is not a big version of one deal: for it to return nothing, every company in it would have to fail at once, so it gets a wider table and no zero branch.

sections.title: What it is
sections.body: A generalist early-stage fund holding 24 companies. Priced off venture fund benchmarks rather than off a single company's odds.
